sentences.en: Yanni must have experienced separation from a major attachment figure.
sentences.zh: 雅尼一定经历过与一个重要依恋对象的分离。

sentences.en: She had a great attachment to that old house.
sentences.zh: 她对那座老房子有着深厚的感情。

sentences.en: Only use attachments or accessories specified by the manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 仅使用制造商指定的附件或配件。
